'''Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)''' is a [[Facilities|facility]] [[item]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|The Protocol PAC (PAC) represents the core technology of Endfield Industries. The seed was planted when they stepped through the door, and it is slowly growing to become a massive technological oak.}}
==Usage==
A massive Endfield core facility that can supply power to various facilities and industrial processes.
